# Extract Text From Image

macOS 12 +

## Notes

Extracts the text from an image

## Syntax

~~~~text
extractTextFromImage(image: <#Variable#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
extractTextFromImage(image: Clipboard)
~~~~
